itens.t: North Korea Fires Salvo of Ballistic Missiles Toward Eastern Sea
itens.r: North Korea launched approximately 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the sea off its eastern coast on Thursday. The provocative launches prompted an immediate emergency meeting of South Korea's National Security Office at Cheong Wa Dae. Seoul strongly urged Pyongyang to immediately cease all further military provocations. The series of missile tests comes amid heightened tensions along the inter-Korean border.
itens.d:
North Korea launched approximately 10 short-range ballistic missiles toward the eastern sea from an area near Wonsan. South Korean armed forces reinforced their vigil, maintaining readiness and sharing information closely with the United States and Japan.

Japan's Ministry of Defense and Coast Guard reported that the projectile landed outside Japan's Exclusive Economic Zone. Pyongyang has tested missiles on more than 10 occasions this year amidst rising border tensions.

itens.t: US Military Captures Rare Image of China's Secretive Space Plane
itens.r: A photograph released by the US military captured China's reusable Shenlong space plane docked to another spacecraft in orbit. The image was taken by Vantor's WorldView 3 satellite from a distance of 56 miles. This rare visual provides new details on Beijing's secretive orbital capabilities.
itens.d:
A U.S. military intelligence agency released a photograph of China's secretive Shenlong space plane docked to another spacecraft in orbit. The image was captured by Vantor's WorldView 3 satellite from a distance of 56 miles.

The high-resolution photograph reveals the robotic space plane with its payload bay doors open while docked to a satellite with deployed solar panels. The image was featured in a report by the Defense Intelligence Agency evaluating adversary space threats.

itens.d:
The Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 to claim their first World Series title in franchise history. It took the team 44 years to return to the Fall Classic following their 1982 appearance against the St. Louis Cardinals.

Cooper Pratt contributed an RBI single in the top of the second inning to help secure the victory. Meanwhile, pitcher Jacob Misiorowski delivered strong fastballs before cramping in the later frames.

itens.t: Astronomers Discover Mysterious Potential Dwarf Planet Beyond Neptune
itens.r: The Vera Rubin Observatory has identified a distant icy object orbiting the sun in the deep expanse beyond Neptune. Designated 2026 ED138, the potential dwarf planet measures up to 1,500 kilometers across.
itens.d:
Astronomers using the Vera Rubin Observatory discovered a potential dwarf planet circulating the sun beyond Neptune. The icy object, designated 2026 ED138, is estimated to be between 600 and 1500 kilometers wide.

Discovered by Matthew Holman using search code developed with Kevin Napier, the body is large enough to be rounded by its own gravity. This finding adds a significant candidate to the limited number of confirmed dwarf planets in the solar system.

itens.t: Brazilian Energy Distributors Face Potential 32% Drop in Itaipu Quotas
itens.r: Energy distribution companies in Brazil could experience a reduction of up to 32.3% in their Itaipu energy quotas by 2027. Calculations released by Abradee highlight potential supply adjustments for the upcoming years.
itens.d:
Energy distribution quotas from the Itaipu hydroelectric plant to Brazilian companies could drop by over 32 percent in 2027. The Abradee association warned that increased energy contracting by Paraguay's Ande may force concessionaires to purchase additional power from other sources.

The association requested that authorities define the deduction amounts before the upcoming energy auction on November 13. Distributors must ratify their purchasing needs while Itaipu quotas remain undetermined near the end of the year.

itens.t: NASA's Webb Space Telescope Captures Turbulent Stellar Nursery
itens.r: A newly released image from the James Webb Space Telescope reveals a chaotic cauldron of active star formation packed with dense gas clumps. The detailed snapshot offers new insights into early stellar evolution.
itens.d:
NASA's James Webb Space Telescope captured an image of the N159 star-forming region located 161,000 light-years away in the Large Magellanic Cloud. The turbulent area is filled with dense clumps of gas and features lower metallicity than the Milky Way.

This unique chemical composition provides astronomers with valuable insights into conditions resembling the early universe. The observation helps researchers better understand how stars form under such specific environments.

itens.t: Decommissioned NASA Telescope Debris Threatens Return to Earth
itens.r: Fragments of the decommissioned Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory are projected to re-enter Earth's atmosphere and potentially land in Brazil. NASA is closely tracking the decaying orbit of the spacecraft.
itens.d:
Debris from NASA's decommissioned Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory could enter Earth's atmosphere and potentially land in Brazil within the coming weeks. The spacecraft travels in an orbit inclined at approximately 20.6 degrees relative to the equator, crossing Brazilian territory.

While space experts note that Brazil falls within the orbital path, predicting the exact re-entry time and location remains uncertain due to atmospheric and solar variables. Specialists emphasize that current data does not confirm an impact in the country.
